title: Additivity of the symplectic form in the first argument
statement:
Let $p$ be prime and work over the space $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$ equipped with the symplectic form $\omega(u,v) = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i)$, where $u = (x,z)$ and $v = (x',z')$. Then for all $x, y, z \in V$,
\[
\omega(x + y, z) = \omega(x, z) + \omega(y, z).
\]
hypotheses_covered: vectors x, y, z in V = F_p^n × F_p^n
replaced: $\omega$ is bilinear: additive and scalar-homogeneous in each argument.
